items.question: Under which clause of the MSA was the change of control notice given?
items.answer:
The change of control notice was given under Clause 14.2 of the MSA. The notice states, "We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc." [2]

Clause 14.2 of the MSA requires the Provider to provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to the Client. [1]

The notice was sent in accordance with Clause 22.1, which outlines the procedure for notices under the Agreement. [6]
